title: dataset_index record (one JSON object per line)

id.description: unique id, also the key used in splits.json

image_path.description: relative to the dataset root, which is /content/uit_hwdb on Colab

gt_text.description: ground truth text, NFC, syllables separated by single spaces

split.description: official split of the dataset, only if it exists for every record

writer_id.description: only if it is known for every record

group_id.description: lines of one group stay in one split, for example the page folder; only if known for every record
